chunks.t: Built-in accessibility features

Light and dark themes, with text colors chosen for readable contrast. Animations switch off when your device asks for reduced motion. Pages are marked as English or Hindi so screen readers pronounce them correctly. Text can be enlarged to 200% without losing content

chunks.t: How we calculate
chunks.x: Manual hours today = invoices × minutes per invoice ÷ 60, plus people in the close × days to close × 8 hours. Hours saved = manual hours × the reduction you choose. Value per year = hours saved × (monthly cost ÷ 160 hours) × 12. Equivalent full-time people = hours saved ÷ 160. Days to close after = days to close × (1 − reduction), never below 1
